Chromogram
====================================================


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
source("compmus.R")

compmus2025 <- read_csv("compmus2025.csv")
```

Column {.tabset}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------
### Track 1 

```{r}
"features/tobias-p-1.json" |>                           
  compmus_chroma(norm = "chebyshev") |>                 
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = pc, fill = value)) + 
  geom_raster() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = 0:11,
    minor_breaks = NULL,
    labels = c(
                "C", "C#|Db", "D", "D#|Eb",
                "E", "F", "F#|Gb", "G",
                "G#|Ab", "A", "A#|Bb", "B"
              )
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = "none") +              
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = NULL, fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic()   
```


### Track 2

```{r}
"features/tobias-p-2.json" |>                          
  compmus_chroma(norm = "chebyshev") |>                
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = pc, fill = value)) +

    breaks = 0:11,
    minor_breaks = NULL,

                "C", "C#|Db", "D", "D#|Eb",
```

Visualisation
====================================================


Column {.tabset}
--------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Arousal

```{r}
ggplot(compmus2025, aes(x=tempo, y=arousal)) + geom_point()
```

### Danceability

```{r}
ggplot(compmus2025, aes(x=tempo, y=danceability)) + geom_point()
```

### Engagingness

```{r}
ggplot(compmus2025, aes(x=tempo, y=engagingness)) + geom_point()
```

### Instrumentalness

```{r}

```

### Valence

```{r}

```
